# OTR Complete EN ↔ zh-Hans Catalog Review

Owner review snapshot · 2026-10-03 (Pacific/Auckland).
**Post-normalization review. Owner Decisions v2 applied to display copy; accepted by owner before Phase D.**

This is the accepted pre-Phase D snapshot of 1,151 keys; Phase D additions are
tracked in [the migration report](UI_FOUNDATION_PHASE_D_REPORT.md).

Normative source: [OTR Terminology Glossary](OTR_TERMINOLOGY_GLOSSARY.md).

Source: [populated catalogs](../../src/ui/catalogs.ts). SHA-256: 2345bc10c0ef5f3f7c63725573697b07b8731590fc746b9ae1da533531baa73d.
Export actual object values, not regex-extracted source literals. Namespace/domain is
the key prefix; generic namespaces span multiple surfaces. Every pair is exported
verbatim, with HTML entities only protecting table syntax/space rendering.

- Exported pairs: **1151**, identical key sets in both populated catalogs.
- Exact identical values: **11**, individually classified below; **0 confirmed omissions** in this class.
- Same normalized English → different Chinese: **15 groups** (E IDs), all key occurrences listed.
- Different normalized English → same Chinese: **40 groups** (Z IDs); review candidates, not confirmed defects.
- Likely untranslated UI candidates: **0 keys**, The former Ledger / Debug Trip candidates are now fixed.
- Machine-looking translated values: **3 keys**, presentation boundary review only.

Normalization folds English case and trims/collapses whitespace; Chinese grouping
trims outer whitespace. Original values remain in tables. Plurals/grammar and different
contexts may legitimately share Chinese. Do not bulk-unify Share (allocation/file action)
or Active (Journey/account).

This is a catalog review, not a repository-wide string migration audit. It does not
certify every screen/error has a key. User-entered data, Journey/person names, persisted
IDs/codes and remote evidence passed through placeholders are not defects. Catalog
entries may be unused or accessed dynamically; export does not prove visibility.

Core product distinctions and recommendations: [core review](OTR_CORE_TERMINOLOGY_REVIEW.md).

## Disposition after final owner decisions

No material unresolved core terminology conflicts remain. The 15 English-variation
groups and 40 Chinese-collision groups below are an occurrence index for contextual
wording, grammar and editorial review, not 55 confirmed translation defects.
Approved semantic distinctions are maintained in the normative glossary; optional
copy polish does not authorize bulk unification. Actual Rate and standalone Final
are intentionally absent as canonical terms. No likely untranslated populated
catalog keys remain under this review; uncatalogued legacy UI is outside this export.
The owner accepted this terminology gate and separately authorized Phase D. This table remains the accepted pre-migration snapshot.

| currencySettings.copy29                                          | Journey Currency is used for spending totals, member balances and final settlement. Each Expense keeps its original amount and currency. Eligible cross-currency Expenses are valued using an accepted historical reference rate for the Expense date; those without an available rate remain unresolved. Only the organizer can change this online after preview and confirmation. Open settlements or conflicts block the change. Any finalized settlement locks this currency permanently. | 行程结算币种用于消费汇总、成员余额和最终结算。每笔支出保留原始金额和币种；符合条件的跨币种支出使用已接受的支出日期历史参考汇率估值，没有可用汇率的支出仍待处理。只有组织者在线预览并确认后才能更改。未完成的结算或冲突会阻止更改。任何最终结算记录都会永久锁定此币种。 | currencySettings | —                                             |
